name: SmartTextArea
tagline: Smart Text Area replaces the plain multi-line text box with one that helps people write answers of the right length.
description: Smart Text Area replaces the plain multi-line text box with one that helps people write answers of the right length. As they type, a counter shows how many words (or characters) they have used against the limit, a thin bar fills up, and a short message tells them when they are below the minimum, close to the maximum or over it. The box grows with the text, so long answers stay readable without scrolling inside a tiny field.
